name: Salmon Pink
source:
Main character finds a way to summon a devil from grandfather's papers. The devil gets the appearance of selected person, so protagonist selects his childhood friend Momo. The devil Pink is same cute as Momo and is absolutely obedient to the hero...

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/01/vn-of-month-november-2000.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公从祖父留下的文献中找到了召唤恶魔的方法。恶魔会化作指定之人的模样，于是主人公选择了青梅竹马桃。恶魔小粉与桃一样可爱，而且对主人公绝对服从…

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/01/vn-of-month-november-2000.html]vndbreview[/url]]
